caption: The drawing depicts a square quilt design composed of a grid with five rows and five columns containing a total of twenty-five blocks. Each block inside the grid features a symmetrical geometric pattern in shades of green with a central diamond shape and radiating triangles, set against an off-white background decorated with intricate, light red swirled and floral motifs. The quilt is surrounded by a wide border consisting of alternating green and diagonal-striped pink-and-white triangles. A small inset square to the right side of the quilt contains a scaled-down version of the geometric pattern, also in green, set on the same off-white and red motif background. The overall color palette includes shades of green, pink, off-white, and light red. The composition is symmetrical and evenly spaced, with clear repetition of motifs and strong contrast of green against the lighter background.
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
